title: Cartwise Shopper Contractor Accounts Monthly Level Evaluation
content:
**Rule.** Levels on Cartwise Shopper Contractor Accounts are evaluated on the level evaluation day (day 1) of each calendar month for active Full-Service accounts; Shop-Only Shopper is outside the ladder and never moves by evaluation. A shopper is promoted to the highest level whose minimum completed batches, minimum rating average and minimum on-time percentage are all met, and a promotion may skip levels. A shopper who fails the current level's requirements keeps it for the level's tolerated number of failed evaluations and then moves down one level only. The level's entitlements change on the evaluation date. Levels are never changed between evaluations except by reactivation. Levels are evaluated only for accounts that are active on the evaluation date.

## The three measures

| Measure | Window | How it is counted |
|---|---|---|
| Completed batches | The 30 calendar days ending the day before the evaluation date | The shopper's batches whose completion date falls in the window |
| On-time percentage | The same 30 days | The share of the shopper's completed delivery orders in the window completed no later than the scheduled window end plus that order's late threshold minutes, as a percentage rounded to 1 decimal |
| Rating average | As of the evaluation | The account's rating average (most recent 100 ratings not excluded) |

## Minimums and tolerance by level

| Level | Batches | Average | On time | Failed evaluations tolerated |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Full-Service Shopper | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 |
| Full-Service Shopper Silver | 40 | 4.8 | 90 | 1 |
| Full-Service Shopper Gold | 80 | 4.85 | 93 | 1 |
| Full-Service Shopper Platinum | 150 | 4.9 | 95 | 1 |
| Full-Service Shopper Diamond | 250 | 4.95 | 97 | 2 |

(Shop-Only Shopper carries 0 in each column but is not evaluated.)

## Demotion under the tolerance (derived)

| Failed evaluations tolerated | Consecutive failed evaluation that moves the level down one |
|---|---|
| 1 (Silver, Gold, Platinum) | The second |
| 2 (Diamond) | The third |

## Worked example (hypothetical figures)

On 1 March an active Full-Service Shopper Silver shows 160 completed batches between 30 January and 28 February (a year in which February has 28 days), a 4.93 average and 96.4% on time. Platinum's minimums (150, 4.9, 95) are all met, Diamond's (250) are not, so the shopper moves to Full-Service Shopper Platinum on 1 March, skipping Gold, and Platinum's entitlements apply from that date. Had the account been on hold on 1 March, it would not have been evaluated.
